title: Foodlink IPO: a wedding caterer's ₹361 crore issue, a profit that doubled, then a half-year loss
short: Foodlink IPO: ₹361 crore, half fresh money, half an exit
dek: The Mumbai luxury caterer opens its IPO at ₹181–₹191 on 26 November. Sales have grown 50% in two years, but the latest six months show a loss.
card: Foodlink caters weddings and runs banquets and restaurants. What its ₹361 crore IPO offers, and what the numbers show.
